caption: Man who has been in the final generation since 1988 confirms he remains in the final generation.
alt: A middle-aged man sits at a kitchen table holding a marker, looking satisfied. Behind him is a whiteboard with the years 1988, 1994, 2000, 2007, 2015, and 2028 all crossed out with arrows pointing to a circled word NOW. A coffee mug on the table reads WATCHMAN. His speech bubble says: Recalculated. Still the last generation.
